visual_action: A montage of clips shows Kamala Harris at various campaign rallies and events. She is seen smiling and waving at crowds, speaking at a podium with the Vice Presidential seal, and walking onto a stage. The crowds are shown holding blue campaign signs, many of which read 'HARRIS WALZ'.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is the sole person featured in the video montage, appearing in every clip.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: His name appears on campaign signs held by the crowd that read 'HARRIS WALZ'.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official account for the Democratic Party, '@democrats'.

on_screen_text.text: this is your sign to vote

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; the audio consists entirely of a song.
audio_music: The video is set to a high-energy, rhythmic pop song ('...Ready For It?' by Taylor Swift) that plays throughout, creating a hype-filled and empowering atmosphere.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various clips of Kamala Harris at rallies and events, synchronized to the beat of the music.
central_claim: Kamala Harris is an energetic and popular candidate, and this video serves as a direct call to action for viewers to vote for her ticket.
intended_effect: To generate excitement and enthusiasm for the Harris campaign and to directly encourage viewers to vote.
